description.value: Wonderlands Coffee & Plants is a community-focused cafe in Squamish, BC, founded by two longtime friends who bought a coffee shop and designed it as a slow-down space for connection. Espresso drinks use locally roasted beans from Moja Coffee in North Vancouver, paired with rotating paninis, overnight oats, and house-made baked goods and juices. The cafe features indoor and outdoor patio seating for up to 50 and regularly hosts events.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active, open coffee shop at #105-39767 Government Road, Squamish, BC, matching the OSM address. The about page explicitly states 'we also have free wifi' and the menu page confirms takeout ('whether you're staying a while or grabbing something to go'). No website evidence addresses bike parking, washrooms, or water refill, and the OSM name includes '& Plants' while the website branding consistently reads 'Wonderlands Coffee' — minor discrepancy noted.
concerns: OSM name is 'Wonderlands Coffee & Plants' but website title and branding consistently uses 'Wonderlands Coffee' (without '& Plants'). Instagram handle @wonderlandscoffeeplants suggests plants are part of the brand identity but the website omits it from the business name.
No phone number present in OSM tags or anywhere on the website; email (info@wonderlandsemporium.com) is the only direct contact method.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible cafe in Squamish with a confirmed website and address. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking coffee, food, and free Wi-Fi.
